kit.hook: The baby has a registry. The parents?

scenes.narration: The baby has a registry. The parents? Cold coffee.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a full mug left on a counter beside baby bottles

scenes.narration: So gift the parents, and stay for the gift that always gets used. First, a heated mug: Best Buy says the Ember Mug 2 holds 120 to 145 degrees for up to an hour and a half.
No-app parents? The Nextmug runs on one button with three presets.
For the grandparents, a Wi-Fi photo frame. New baby photos arrive without a single text.
For 3 a.m. feeds, a book light. Small, quiet, and very appreciated.
Skip blankets, pillows and stuffed toys for the crib. Bare is best, says the CPSC.
Or give help. "Dinner on the 14th" gets used. "Let me know" never does.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a handwritten card promising dinner on a date

scenes.narration: On the 14th, dinner arrives, and the coffee is still warm. The full list is at the link.
